text:
rachel.pm: uploaded new mocks. main asks: make invite role-first, pick SSO wording, and make audit filters keyboard-friendly
luca.design: role-first looks cleaner. concern: invite CTA competes with role chips in the matrix visually
tori-ux: solution: downscale CTA color + add small caret to imply modal vs inline. ensure focus styles visible
mohit (eng): prefer role pill as the single control (aria-expanded) to reduce extra buttons for screen readers
rachel.pm: SSO label options: 'SSO required' vs 'Require SSO for org' 9 which should be the toggle label?
luca.design: label='SSO required', helper='All new users must sign in via your SSO provider.' keeps UI compact
tori-ux: add aria-describedby linking toggle to helper. also announce state changes in live region for screen readers
mohit (eng): when SSO flips, emit audit event type 'sso_policy_change' with before/after and actor id. ops wants tenant_id included
ops-bot: reminder: audit retention needs request_id and tenant_id on events
rachel.pm: audit nav: user feedback says invite events are hard to find. proposal: horizontal filter chips with counts above the list
luca.design: chips + counts good. accessibility: roving tabindex so arrow keys move focus and Enter applies filter. announce "Invites filter applied, X results"
mohit (eng): will add GET /audit/summary?org_id=... to return counts to avoid client-side counting
rachel.pm: invite flow copy: replace 'Invite members by email' with role-first inline: [Role v] [Email] [Send]. show expiry 'Invitation expires in 7 days'
tori-ux: ensure modal traps focus, return focus on close, and role picker keyboard interactions (Enter to open, arrows to navigate, Esc to cancel)
mohit (eng): inline edits should emit 'role_inline_update' events with before/after. mobile fallback opens a bottom sheet
rachel.pm: compliance asks: all audit-nav routes must accept view=auditable query param for automated scraping
mohit (eng): will add route shim and keep default behavior
ops-bot: deploy queued to staging after reviews; summary: role-first invites, SSO label + helper, roving tabindex for audit filters, inline role edit events, audit summary endpoint
